content.short: SoBloks is a decentralized social media platform on Cardano that rewards content creators and engagement.
content.description: SoBloks is a pioneering decentralized social media platform built on the Cardano blockchain to empower content creators and users. By utilizing the native $BLOK token, the platform rewards participants for social engagement and community interaction. SoBloks provides a transparent alternative to traditional media, featuring a decentralized advertising system and self-service NFT tools for creators to monetize their work. Its mission is to foster a circular economy where users maintain control over their data while being rewarded for their contributions to the ecosystem.
